The '''Morellian Trail''' was an ancient [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that existed between [[Telos IV]] and [[Farana/Legends|Farana]] before the charter of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. It had a spur at [[Listehol system/Legends|Listehol]] that ran a short distance to [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]].
